LEGACY Key Collation — Strategy

Projectname domains DB · 2026-07-01 · Feature 3049

Decision

Rebuild + Centralize. Rebuild the database so text is case-sensitive by default (a Binary-Default (BIN2) Store), and handle case-insensitive search in one place (a Centralized Search Layer). Build the layer first, flip the store second.

The vocabulary

Mixed-Collation Storedb · today
Keys case-sensitive, everything else not. Where the two meet is what throws the errors.
Binary-Default (BIN2) Storedb · target
All text case-sensitive by default. The error class disappears — but search must be made case-insensitive on purpose.
Inline Collationapp · today
Each query hand-adds case-handling — ~400 scattered spots. Easy to miss; the cause of the repeats.
Centralized Search Layerapp · target
One module all search flows through. Case-insensitivity lives in exactly one place.
Collation GateCI · shipped
A build check that blocks anyone reintroducing the problem or bypassing the layer.
Persisted CI Indexdb
A stored, indexed case-insensitive copy of a column — keeps search fast on a Binary-Default (BIN2) Store.

Two choices → four combinations

There are two independent knobs: how the database stores text (case-sensitive or not) and how the app does case-insensitive search (scattered or in one place). Two options each = four combinations. We're in one corner today and moving to the opposite corner.

In plain terms:

  • Patch-and-Guard (today) — old database, fix each search spot by hand + a gate to catch misses. Works, but fragile.
  • Centralize-First — old database, but search handled in one place. A safe half-step we pass through.
  • Bare Rebuild — new database, but still fixing search by hand. The trap: silent wrong results.
  • Rebuild + Centralize (goal) — new database and search in one place.

How it's built

The search layer lives in the app, not the database. All Projectname SQL is hand-written in apps/api (no ORM), so that's where the one shared search module belongs. The database only stores (case-sensitive) and provides fast indexes. Enforcement is in CI.

The one rule

Build the search layer before flipping the store. Flip first and ~194 searches silently turn case-sensitive — wrong results, no error, no failing test. The layer is the safety net that makes the flip safe.

The plan

✓
Bridge (now). Keep Patch-and-Guard live — the shipped fix + Collation Gate keep dev working through the rebuild.
1
Build the Centralized Search Layer in apps/api. Route all search / filter / sort through it. The big step.
2
Flip the store. Rebuild domains as a Binary-Default (BIN2) Store, reload data, add Persisted CI Indexes.
3
Simplify. Remove the old scattered collation; point the gate at "use the layer."
